name: ai-spice
displayName: AI-SPICE — LTspice & Electronic Circuit Engineering MCP Server
description: Closed-loop LTspice batch simulation, multi-domain E12/E24/E96 analytical circuit sizing (Op-Amps, BJTs, MOSFETs, Active/Passive Filters, RF Oscillators & Matching, Power), Vision-to-SPICE schematic photo reconstruction, and 16px-grid orthogonal signal-wired .asc schematic compiler (NC_ = 0).

tools.name: ia_spice_snap_series
tools.description: Snap a theoretical R/L/C value to the nearest commercial E12, E24, or E96 standard series value.

tools.name: ia_spice_size_bjt_stage
tools.description: Analytically size a BJT DC operating point (R1, R2, RC, RE) in E24 values with thermal stability and small-signal gm, r_pi, Z_in, Z_out.

tools.name: ia_spice_size_colpitts
tools.description: Size a Colpitts LC oscillator capacitive feedback network (C1, C2) and evaluate Barkhausen startup margin (gm * Rp).

tools.name: ia_spice_size_circuit_block
tools.description: General-purpose analytical sizing for Op-Amp stages, MOSFET stages, Passive RC/RLC filters, Active Sallen-Key filters, RF L-section matching networks, and precision voltage/feedback dividers.

tools.name: ia_spice_run_simulation
tools.description: Run headless LTspice (-b) on a .cir or .asc file, parse all .meas results, and execute physics-based failure diagnostics.

tools.name: ia_spice_verify_schematic_asc
tools.description: Formally verify an LTspice .asc schematic via LTspice -netlist, checking for zero floating pins (NC_ = 0) and netlist isomorphism.

tools.name: ia_spice_import_vision_graph
tools.description: Reconstruct a complete LTspice .cir netlist and wired .asc schematic from a schematic photo/image (supports ask_user and autonomous modes).

tools.name: ia_spice_edit_ltspice_project
tools.description: Inspect, beautify, modify components, add components, or compile a .cir netlist into a functionally grouped, signal-wired .asc schematic.
